repairNotes:
Both portrait eyes now share the same plain iris design, with the same change made in ILLUSTRATION.svg and the SVG inside index.html. Nothing was rendered, so the card-size look still needs your check. I also didn't open eye-after-render.png; I worked from your description of it.

- **Near eye:** I removed the dotted white band in the lower iris. In its place is a thin, smooth white crescent along the bottom of the iris (`iris-light-near`), about 20 px wide and 4 px tall.
- **Far eye:** I added a matching smaller crescent near the bottom of the iris (`iris-light-far`), about 11 px wide and 3 px tall. It is sized for the narrower, turned eye, so the iris should no longer look like a solid black button.

In both eyes the crescent is drawn on the iris before the pupil, and it sits just below the pupil, so the pupil still reads clearly. Each eye keeps its single main highlight at the upper left, so the light comes from the same direction in both. The crescents stay inside their irises and the eye outlines, and the upper lids still overlap the top of each iris as before.

The crescents are inside the existing gaze groups, so they move with the iris. The eye openings, masks, gaze timing, other artwork and the scripts in index.html are unchanged.
